release_notes: Six gaps found in review, all closed. The Keitaro dump command is back on the Migrations page (a refactor had dropped it, leaving scp commands that fetch a file nothing creates — step 1 now shows the full server-side command again). The conversion-failure alert actually sends to Telegram now: orbitraSendConversionAlert() used to log a line and report success; it delivers through the panel's own bot to every chat with /notify on. Retention cleanup ("log retention" / "archive retention") is finally scheduled: install.sh adds the cli/cleanup_cron.php daily cron and the update self-heal installs it on existing installs — before, the fields were saved while nothing ever purged. Non-admins no longer 403 on logs_param_keys (the traffic-log column suggestions) and cohort (Analytics): both fell into the resource map's default-deny hole. The dead "Update Costs" modal is gone from the campaign editor — every input in it was unwired, including the "unique clicks only" checkbox; the working one in the Campaigns list stays. And .env.example stops telling people to copy it to .env (PHP never reads that file — the variables belong in the PHP-FPM pool or the Apache vhost, with examples). The documentation is in English now: the GitHub wiki publishes docs/ as 32 English pages, Russian versions live in docs/ru/ and the internal spec pages are no longer published.
